description: The single entry point for Fields of the World (FTW) global field-boundary data. The collections in this catalog are the **2nd Edition**, the current release: per-year vector and raster collections of FTW global field-boundary predictions. These are model predictions of remote-sensing field units, not cadastral or legal parcels or a land-tenure product. The 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 collections describe the updated processing recipe. The other year links retain previously published collections; their presence does not indicate completion of the updated processing for those years. Use each year collection for its provenance and asset inventory. The **1st Edition** — 10 m PRUE predictions for 2024 and 2025, with prediction-confidence layers, probability Zarr and Sentinel-2 composites — is published separately, under `ftw/global-data/first-edition`, and hangs off this catalog as the [Fields of the World — Global Data (1st Edition)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/global-data/first-edition/catalog.json) sub-catalog. The two editions come from different models at different resolutions over different years, so they are alternatives rather than versions of one layer.
